marketPlan: United States first; expand internationally only where the final product is permitted and supported.
scope: FYNX is its own product. Owner crypto tools support Ethereum Sepolia and Base Sepolia test transactions, plus read-only Base mainnet. Public access stays on the waitlist. No MoonPay integration is planned.

items.title: One FYNX website and a live waitlist
items.current: GitHub hosts the public site and owner dashboard. Firebase stores confirmed registrations with consent and retention metadata.
items.next: Maintain the waitlist until the public-launch gates are approved.

items.title: Account login and recovery
items.current: Google, email/password and passkeys are implemented for the verified owner. Virtual passkey and authorization tests passed.
items.next: Test Google, email recovery, passkey creation/sign-in/removal, and browser attestation on actual supported devices. Account recovery does not recover wallet funds.

items.title: Separate accounts for every customer
items.current: Public customer accounts are deliberately closed; the backend authorizes one owner.
items.next: Implement per-user profiles, wallet ownership, session revocation, abuse limits and cross-account isolation tests on the selected production infrastructure. Open registration only after approval.

items.title: Wallet creation and recovery
items.current: Version one connects an existing user-controlled wallet. FYNX does not create a wallet, generate 24 words, or recover signing keys from email.
items.next: Prove external-wallet recovery first. If creating a wallet inside FYNX is required, select and independently review key generation, encrypted storage, device/passkey access, backup, export and recovery before implementation. Never ask users for an existing Ledger phrase.

items.title: Send, receive and signing
items.current: ETH and canonical USDC test transfers have address/network/fee review, token simulation, bounded amounts, one-use approval and receipt lookup. Receive QR codes include the chain and asset. Real contracts executed successfully in an isolated Base Sepolia fork.
items.next: Record physical-wallet approval/rejection, public testnet transfers and independent recipient balances. Test recovery and supported browsers/devices. Mainnet signing remains disabled.

items.title: Live assets, balances and transaction history
items.current: Live ETH/USDC balances on Ethereum Sepolia, Base Sepolia and read-only Base. Session transaction journal and hash lookup are implemented. The separate dashboard remains a simulation.
items.next: Add complete indexed transaction history, reliable production RPC/failover, replacement/reorg handling and market prices. Bitcoin and Solana are not implemented.

items.title: Buy and sell through cards or bank accounts
items.current: A server-only Transak sandbox checkout and order-status adapter is implemented with fixed hosts, verified-wallet binding and private secrets. No partner credentials are supplied; it fails closed. No live payments are enabled.
items.next: Create a provider sandbox account, enable BUY/SELL, arrange required IP allowlisting and supply staging credentials in Secret Manager. Test purchases, sales, cancellations, refunds and reconciliation. Business approval, production credentials and legal review are separate gates.

items.title: Swap assets safely
items.current: Direct ETH/USDC Uniswap v3 swaps on Base Sepolia: bounded slippage/price impact, one-minute quotes, exact/reset/revoke approvals, simulation and on-chain minimum output. Base mainnet quotes are read-only. Local-fork swaps passed in both directions.
items.next: Verify public-testnet and hardware-wallet execution; independently review the pinned contracts, pricing/manipulation risks, routing, fee handling and production release policy. Mainnet swaps stay disabled.

items.title: Production security and independent audit
items.current: Owner authorization, App Check, challenge replay protection, dependency checks and an internal review are in place. Current GitHub origin and Firebase project are shared with other applications.
items.next: Choose a dedicated production origin/backend boundary, configure response headers and secrets/IAM, retest App Check on normal browsers, and commission an independent signing/auth review with fixes and retesting.

items.title: Publish only verified releases
items.current: The Pages workflow waits for tests, generated-file checks and dependency audits. Only approved public assets are packaged, with a revision/hash manifest.
items.next: Keep deployment gated; use the published manifest and Actions run to identify each release. Backend deployments and rollbacks remain separately scoped.

items.title: Monitoring, backups and incident recovery
items.current: Audit retention, rate limits, a connection check and an incident procedure exist. There is no tested alert recipient or restore drill.
items.next: Assign monitored support/security contacts, set failure/authorization/billing alerts, test delivery, select backup retention and recovery objectives, and restore into an isolated environment. Connection checks are not continuous monitoring.

items.title: U.S. launch permissions and consumer protections
items.current: The owner supplied the name FYNX finance world inc. and selected the United States as the first intended market. Incorporation state, registration details and legal permissions are unverified.
items.next: Confirm entity details and the exact custody/payment model. Have counsel determine federal/state licensing, AML/KYC, sanctions, age/eligibility, privacy, consumer terms, disclosures and complaints duties. Finish the required registrations, contracts and controls before serving customers.

items.title: International availability
items.current: Worldwide access is a future goal, not current eligibility or authorization.
items.next: Approve each country and product separately for local requirements, sanctions, payment/provider coverage, data handling and support. Implement an approved-country policy before expansion; do not promise all countries.

items.title: Controlled public launch
items.current: Public customers remain on the waitlist. No launch date, real-funds readiness or flawless operation is claimed.
items.next: After the applicable gates pass, run a small approved pilot with limits, staffed support, recovery/incident procedures, reconciliation, measured reliability and a rollback decision. Obtain explicit owner release approval before removing the waitlist.
